chunks.title: Kerala Marine Fishing Regulation Act (KMFRA) — Operational Guidelines & Mesh Specifications
chunks.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Kerala
chunks.legal_reference: Kerala Act 10 of 1980 & Subsequent Amendments (KMFRA)
chunks.content: 1. Territorial Water Zoning: Kerala territorial waters (up to 12 nautical miles from baseline) are stratified for resource protection. The nearshore zone up to 10 kilometers (approx. 5.4 nautical miles) is exclusively reserved for traditional non-motorized and small motorized artisanal fishermen. Mechanized trawlers are strictly prohibited from operating within this 10 km artisanal reserve.

chunks.title: Tamil Nadu Marine Fisheries Regulation Act & Palk Strait / IMBL Operational Advisory
chunks.authority: Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu & Indian Coast Guard
chunks.legal_reference: TNMFR Act 1983 & Joint Coast Guard Security Protocol
chunks.content: 1. Palk Bay Token & Rotation System: To prevent conflict between traditional fishermen and mechanized trawlers in the narrow Palk Strait, fishing operations from Rameswaram, Mandapam, and Jagadapattinam follow a strict 3-day / 4-day weekly rotational token schedule. Mechanized boats may only venture out on specified token days (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday mornings).
